name: TLCC GDPR Cookie Consent
author: techlogica

sections.description:
• Accept/Reject/Customize with category toggles
  • Blocks scripts until consent (Preferences / Analytics / Marketing)
  • Blocks embeds and any HTML blocks via shortcodes
  • Optional Google Consent Mode v2 support
  • Anonymous consent logs (audit trail) with CSV export (Tools → TLCC Consent Logs)

Shortcodes:
* [tlcc_settings_link]
* [tlcc_reset_consent]
* [tlcc_iframe category=”marketing” src=”https://www.youtube.com/embed/…”]
* [tlcc_block category=”marketing”]…[/tlcc_block]
sections.installation:
1. Upload ZIP and activate.
  2. Settings → TLCC GDPR Consent.
  3. Paste scripts per category, and use shortcodes for embeds/blocked content.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Professional UI + categories
  • Script blocking + embed/content blocking
  • Optional Google Consent Mode v2
  • Anonymous consent logs + CSV export
